posts.title: Corporate rentals: beyond the hotel
posts.excerpt: Why companies choose serviced apartments for extended stays.
posts.body:
For stays lasting several weeks or months, a serviced apartment combines the space of a home with hotel-style operations.

Benefits for HR and travelers

  • More square meters and a fully equipped kitchen
  • Predictable costs under contract
  • Locations close to offices and airports

Explore our corporate solutions and request access to the booking portal.

posts.title: Buenos Aires and Quito: two destinations, one standard
posts.excerpt: How we keep the same hospitality experience in Argentina and Ecuador.
posts.body:
At Top Rentals we operate towers in Buenos Aires and Quito with a unified standard: equipped apartments, clear check-in processes, and local support teams.

Consistency across cities makes business travel and regional relocations easier.

If your company rotates team members between countries, using the same provider reduces operational friction and improves team satisfaction.
posts.seoDescription: Consistent hospitality for short-term rentals in Buenos Aires and Quito.

posts.title: What to look for in a short-term rental
posts.excerpt: Location, included services, and flexibility: a quick guide to choosing your next apartment.
posts.body:
Choosing a short-term rental goes beyond the nightly rate. Think about location relative to work or meetings, connectivity, and whether the building offers hotel-style services.

Services that make the difference

Housekeeping, 24-hour reception, quality Wi‑Fi, and well-kept common areas often define the experience as much as the apartment itself.

Flexibility

For corporate stays or families, being able to extend the booking without moving mid-stay saves time and cost.
posts.seoDescription: Guide to choosing a short-term rental: location, services, and flexibility.
